entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, and you've reached VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need to return a pair of cycling shoes I bought about a month ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Vent cycling shoes, delivered 33 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's the fit. They just aren't working for me. I've tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but I keep getting painful blisters on every ride.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is the last thing you want on a ride. Let me quickly confirm the return eligibility for you... One moment.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I've checked our policy, and since the shoes were delivered 33 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can definitely process a full refund for you.

That's great, thank you. I appreciate that. Since I did have a poor experience with the fit and have to go through the process of shipping them back, would it be possible to also get a 15% discount code for my next purchase? I'm planning to order a different pair of shoes from you today.

I understand the request, and I'm glad you're giving another one of our products a try. However, our system is set up to provide the full refund as the resolution in these cases. We aren't able to stack a discount code on top of a return.
I see. So no goodwill gesture for the trouble? Even a 10% code would be helpful.

I do apologize, but my system is firm on this. The best I can offer is the full refund for the cycling shoes, which I have initiated for you. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account. Once we receive the item, the refund will be processed.
Alright, that's fair. A full refund is what I called for. Thanks for your help, Diana.
You're most welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
